data.exact_reserve_text: The overall calendar year result is the aggregate of the calendar year results of all years of account. The annual accounting result is a profit of GBP 1.7 million before currency translation differences in the year (2013: loss GBP 2.0 million) and this can be analysed as follows: ... Balance on Technical Account before investment return ... 2012* account 3,614 ... 2013 account 4,574. * The 2012 account includes the movement in the 2007 to 2011 accounts which have closed into the 2012 account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: settled in July producing a satisfactory reserve release

named_events.loss_description: small increases seen in areas affected by Hurricane Sandy

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a total gross prior year reserve release of GBP 8.188 million. This was driven by favorable development across multiple prior underwriting years. The 2012 account, which includes movements from 2007 to 2011, generated a profit of GBP 3.614 million, partly due to the satisfactory settlement of a long-running disputed claim from the 2011 underwriting year. The 2013 account also contributed a profit of GBP 4.574 million, reflecting a small surplus as the book runs off.
raw_causal_phrases: pure and prior year underwriting profit

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table is presented in loss ratios (percentages) rather than absolute amounts. Prior year development was calculated from the explicit breakdown of the 'Balance on Technical Account before investment return' by account year, which is a direct and reliable source.
